name: Silicone Mat with Measurements For Baking Mat, Dough Pad with Scales Sugar craft, Fondant
description:
Silicone Baking Mat with Measurements – Dough Pad for Sugar Craft & Fondant 🍰

Features:

Made from food-grade silicone; stain-proof, stick-resistant, and durable

Size: 15.7" × 19.7" × 0.05"

Temperature Resistant: -40°F to 480°F – safe from freezer to microwave or oven

Flexible, non-stick surface ensures easy release without grease

Ideal for kneading, rolling, and shaping bread, pizza dough, pastries, pie crusts, pasta, and fondant

Provides a clean, extra-large preparation surface

Rust-resistant and long-lasting

Description:
Upgrade your baking experience with this versatile silicone baking mat. Its non-stick, flexible surface makes rolling, kneading, and shaping dough effortless, while the printed measurements help achieve precise results. Heat- and cold-resistant, this mat is perfect for both professional bakers and home chefs, making it a must-have accessory for every kitchen.
